local_gate.scope: The written theorem excludes the listed routes and local pairs on this point or region. A failed sufficient cone test does not prove face overlap. The two strict curvature-sum halves and general Lemma L remain open.

net.scope: Every parameter tuple in the explicit region, not a universal n=6 theorem
net.arithmetic: Exact rational polynomials and outward dyadic intervals

angular_intrusion.scope: No line through w separates this petal from the opposite fan triangle. Angular overlap alone does not imply face overlap or a failure of Lemma L.

radial_clearance.scope: On every shared ray, the petal starts at least this factor farther from w than the opposite fan edge. Only the stated point or parameter region is covered.
